📚 Hard vocab word #125: MUNIFICENCE

munificence (noun): great generosity.

✅ In a sentence: Thanks to the donor's munificence, every student received a free laptop.
✅ Similar: generosity, largesse, liberality
✅ Remember it: Adjective: munificent.
